description: Plans for translation growth. Pass `strings` (one UI string per line), optionally `languages` (two-letter codes from de, fr, es, pt, it, nl, ru, pl, fi, tr, vi, id, ar, he, hi, th, ja, ko, zh; default de, fr, es, ru, fi, ja, ar) and `maxChars` (the character capacity of your container). For each string returns the planned character range per language and the worst case, and flags strings that exceed maxChars. Short strings expand proportionally more than long ones, so the table applies a length boost. Factors are rule-of-thumb ranges for ordinary UI copy (convention), not measurements; CJK shrinks in characters but can grow in width and height. Run real translations before locking a layout.

maxChars.description: Character capacity of the container, optional.
